items.rationale: The source survey is necessary under §7.1.7(e), and this is the detection firm's first attendance charge under §7.1.7(f). Allow €145 gross for attendance and the initial survey, without counting the separately itemised tests twice.
Locating the source is covered under §7.1.7(e). Allow €220 gross for one specialist pinpointing service, not for a separate charge for the contractor's own instrument under §7.1.8(b).

items.description: Kitchen floor and wall-base moisture measurement
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(e) expressly covers measuring the extent of moisture in the affected parts. Allow €115 gross for one measurement survey of the kitchen floor and wall base.

Sections 7.1.7(g) and 7.1.8(c) allow only necessary skilled time not already priced into the survey and tests. For this localised leak, estimate 2.5 additional hours at €95 gross per hour, rounded to €238, rather than allowing all 14 hours.

Section 7.1.7(f) allows only the first attendance or travel charge per contractor per invoice; line 1 is the first. The €60 estimate would apply only if this were established as the first eligible travel charge.
Necessary access to the documented leak is part of the repair under §§7.1.1(b) and 7.1.5. Allow about two hours at €95 gross per hour for localised access beneath the sink.

items.description: Remove and dispose of damaged insulation
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(a) and 5.2.1 cover necessary removal and disposal of the affected insulation. Allow 2 pieces at €22 gross each for this small quantity.

items.description: Repair leaking copper pipe and reinstate insulation
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.2 and 2.4.3(a) distinguish the resulting water damage from the pipe repair; the localised failure and section replacement support treating the latter as a covered pipe fracture. Allow €425 gross for repair labour, short copper section, fittings and like-for-like insulation, excluding the access charged on line 6.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7(b) require established event-related moisture in the area dried; only the kitchen floor and wall base were affected. The €250 estimate is conditional on proof of a limited roof-space drying job attributable to this leak.
Necessary equipment hire for the affected kitchen is covered under §7.1.7(b) and (e). Allow about 14 days at €18 gross per day, provided the hire is not already charged elsewhere.

items.description: Drying service for kitchen floor and wall base
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(b) and (e) cover drying and monitoring the documented wet areas. Allow €360 gross for setup, monitoring and collection, with dryer hire counted only on line 10 under §7.1.8(c).

items.description: Transition pieces and insulation for repaired pipe
items.rationale: The first pipe repair charge on line 8 already covers completing and insulating this section; §7.1.8(c) bars duplicate costs across trades. The €85 estimate is conditional on evidence of distinct, necessary materials not already included in that repair.
General cleaning is excluded by §7.1.8(a), though removal of identifiable loss or repair residue can qualify under §5.2.1. Allow €55 gross only if the contractor substantiates that narrower scope.
This is the first travel charge on the drying contractor's invoice and is allowed under §7.1.7(f). Allow one ordinary local trip at €65 gross.

items.description: Remove damaged kitchen table from dwelling
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(h) expressly covers removal of a furnishing item being replaced. Allow €40 gross for carrying out the table, separate from off-site transport and disposal.

items.description: Haul away and dispose of damaged table
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.7(h) and 5.2.1 cover transport and disposal of the damaged insured table. Allow €70 gross for the two billed operations together, excluding removal from the dwelling already priced on line 15.

The scheduled new-for-old option under §§4.4 and 7.1.1(d) removes the age deduction. The same model costs €440 net, or €523.60 gross at 19% VAT, assuming VAT was incurred and is not recoverable under §7.7.
Delivery is expressly covered under §7.1.7(h). Allow €45 gross for one local delivery, without duplicating any mileage charged elsewhere.

items.description: Assemble table and clean its placement area
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(h) covers both setting up the replacement and cleaning the spot where the damaged table stood. Allow €65 gross for the combined work on a plain pine table.
Section 7.1.7(f) permits the first vehicle charge on this invoice if it is distinct from table delivery and haulage already charged under §7.1.7(h). Allow €45 gross for one separate local attendance.

items.description: Carpentry vehicle charge for return visit
items.rationale: Section 7.1.7(f) excludes repeat travel charges on the same invoice after line 20. The €45 estimate represents one ordinary local trip only if it were established as the first eligible travel charge.

items.description: Moisture inspection of other furniture in the garden
items.rationale: Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) exclude testing items not established as affected by the kitchen leak. The €70 estimate is conditional on evidence that the inspection concerned insured furniture actually damaged by this event.
